name: Jamie Anne
description: US skincare brand founded by aesthetician Jamie of Jamie Anne Aesthetics, selling its own skincare line through jamieanne.co and running 'The Healthy Skin Club' ambassador program for creators through Roster.

evidence.summary: Jamie Anne's own ambassadors page ('The Healthy Skin Club', run via Roster) publishes the pay structure: 20% commission on Jamie Anne products and 10% on everything else from day one, rising to 30% on Jamie Anne products at the Inner Circle tier; followers get 10% off their first order. There is no follower-count gate (US-based, 18+), commissions are tracked and paid monthly via Roster, ambassadors receive free product through content campaigns, and higher tiers carry product credits of $200+. The page calls the program brand new and recruiting founding ambassadors, but publishes no absolute creator counts, so saturation is recorded as unknown; no earnings-cap statement is published, so the cap is recorded as unknown.

The page presents the brand as the skincare line of founder Jamie (Jamie Anne Aesthetics) and the ambassador program as a four-tier creator program with product credits, confirming a consumer skincare brand selling through its own store.

opportunity.title: The Healthy Skin Club ambassador program

reasons.niche_fit: Skincare-first brand whose ambassador program is built specifically for beauty and skincare creators.
reasons.ugc_evidence: Program page recruits content creators as founding ambassadors, with free product through content campaigns and tiered product credits.
reasons.compensation: 20% on the brand's own products from day one (10% on other products), rising to 30% at the Inner Circle tier; monthly payouts via Roster.
reasons.contact_access: Open application page on the brand's own site; no direct email published.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Applications open now with no follower-count gate; US-based and 18+ only.
reasons.credibility: Esthetician-founded brand selling through its own store with published program terms.

name: Om Organics

evidence.summary: Om Organics' own affiliate and ambassador terms page states: 'Earn a 15% commission on every sale referred through your unique affiliate code or link.' Applications are accepted at the brand's sole discretion and active ambassadors receive product refills. The terms publish no earnings-cap statement, so the cap is recorded as unknown, and no creator counts, so saturation is recorded as unknown.

reasons.niche_fit: Clean, plant-based skincare is a core beauty-creator niche.
reasons.ugc_evidence: Ambassador side of the program includes product refills for active ambassadors, indicating ongoing creator relationships.
reasons.compensation: Flat 15% commission on every referred sale, stated in the brand's own terms.
reasons.contact_access: Program terms and application route are published on the brand's own site; no direct email published.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Applications open, but acceptance is at the brand's sole discretion.
reasons.credibility: Established Canadian clean-beauty brand selling through its own store.

name: Oh Beauty

name: Cleure

name: Natasha Denona
description: Prestige makeup brand founded by makeup artist Natasha Denona, selling through natashadenona.com and retailers worldwide, and running its own affiliate program operated by Natasha Denona Makeup LLC.

evidence.summary: Natasha Denona's official affiliate program terms (Natasha Denona Makeup LLC, effective July 7, 2025) confirm an application-and-approval program for bloggers and social media creators: affiliates earn 'a commission of a certain percentage' and the brand 'reserves the right to offer each affiliate a different commission rate upon its sole discretion' — the rate is not published (affiliates are even barred from disclosing it), so commission_rate is recorded as null. Commissions are paid monthly by bank transfer with a €150 minimum payout. The terms publish no earnings-cap statement and no creator counts, so cap and saturation are recorded as unknown.

reasons.niche_fit: Prestige makeup with very high creator demand and strong tutorial content fit.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The program's own terms are written for bloggers and social media creators and license the brand to reshare affiliate content.
reasons.compensation: Rate is set per affiliate at the brand's sole discretion and never published, so compensation cannot be scored higher.
reasons.contact_access: Application route is published in the official terms; no direct email published.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Application plus brand approval; €150 minimum payout threshold is comparatively high.
reasons.credibility: Globally distributed prestige brand operated by Natasha Denona Makeup LLC.
